prose: Simon Willison releases web-edit 0.1a0, a Python web app with a UI for viewing and editing files in a folder. He built it, with Codex and GPT-6 Astra Extra High, after wanting to edit a credentials file from his phone via Codex Remote without passing the credentials through the model. Basis: the feed excerpt of the release note.
highlights: web-edit 0.1a0: a web UI to view and edit files in a folder.
Motivation: edit secrets without round-tripping them through an LLM.
Built with Codex and GPT-6 Astra Extra High.
